scripts.build: pnpm --filter @guild-os/domain build && pnpm --filter @guild-os/postgres build && pnpm --filter custom-gatekeeper build && pnpm --filter error-reporter build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @guild-os/domain test && pnpm --filter @guild-os/postgres test && pnpm --filter custom-gatekeeper test && pnpm --filter error-reporter test
scripts.types:check: pnpm --filter @guild-os/domain types:check && pnpm --filter @guild-os/postgres types:check && pnpm --filter custom-gatekeeper types:check && pnpm --filter error-reporter types:check
